entities.summary: Kim Jin-young, also known as Dex (Korean: 덱스), is a South Korean entertainer, actor, YouTuber and former ROKN UDT soldier. He is best known for appearing in Toy Soldiers: Fake Men 2 (2020), Single's Inferno Season 2 (2022-2023),  Bloody Game 2 (2023), Adventure by Accident (2023-2025), Zombieverse (2023-2024), and Fresh off the Sea (2024).
